verdict.rationale: Calendly documents routing forms that screen and qualify people before they book (calendly-docs-11). Routes can be built from visible or hidden fields of native or imported forms (calendly-docs-43), and leads can be matched to their assigned account owners via Salesforce and HubSpot (calendly-docs-10). Supporting evidence includes routing forms alongside meeting distribution tools (calendly-docs-17), round-robin and team scheduling (calendly-docs-38), conversion reporting (calendly-docs-44), and a routing_form_submission webhook (calendly-docs-73). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of routing in practice, and explicit documentation that a route can target a team or round-robin pool rather than a single owner.
